descriptionChirho: To seek with intensity or persistence, to desire earnestly or search for diligently; used of seeking signs, spiritual realities, a homeland, or material things (Matt 6:32, 12:39, 16:4; Luke 12:30; Rom 11:7; Phil 4:17; Heb 11:14, 13:14).
To search for a specific person, seeking to locate them physically (Acts 12:19, of Herod searching for Peter).
